# quay_repository (Resource)

Manages a Quay repository.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "quay_organization" "example" {
  name  = "my-org"
  email = "admin@example.com"
}

resource "quay_repository" "example" {
  namespace   = quay_organization.example.name
  name        = "my-app"
  visibility  = "private"
  description = "Container images for my-app"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the repository.
- `namespace` (String) The namespace (organization or username) that owns the repository.
- `visibility` (String) The visibility of the repository. One of: public, private.

### Optional

- `description` (String) A markdown description of the repository.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The resource identifier (namespace/name).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by namespace/name
terraform import quay_repository.example my-org/my-app
```
